name: Small Bubble
flavor: Small Bubble knows he's small, but that doesn't make him any less important.

name: Medium Bubble
flavor: The Medium Bubble is very similar to the Small Bubble, but slightly larger.

name: Large Bubble
flavor: Large Bubble's increased size makes him a vital part of large tanks.

name: Huge Bubble
flavor: Huge Bubble's size is kinda too big, however for some tanks it is acceptable.

name: Huge Base Bubble
flavor: A large stationary Bubble with a lower Bubble Cost, good place to add weapons too.

name: Small Dark Bubble
flavor: Small Bubble knows he's small, but that doesn't make him any less important.

name: Medium Dark Bubble
flavor: The Medium Bubble is very similar to the Small Bubble, but slightly larger.

name: Large Dark Bubble
flavor: Large Bubble's increased size makes him a vital part of large tanks.

name: Wiggle Cluster
summary: Bubble Cluster (Decorative)
flavor: A small bubble cluster that wiggles a little. Fancy eh?

name: Air Bladder Cluster
summary: Bubble Cluster (Decorative)
flavor: These bubbles fill up with air and then shoot it out! Now if only we knew what they are good for...

name: Tentacle Cluster
summary: Bubble Cluster (Decorative)
flavor: It's a tentacle!  Eww.

name: Smooth Tentacle
summary: Bubble Cluster (Decorative)
flavor: It's a bigger tentacle!  Eeeewwwww.  This one is less erratic.

name: Sliding Cluster
summary: Bubble Cluster (Decorative)
flavor: The sliding cluster allows for spikes, shifts, horns, all kinds of things really.

name: Basic Cannon
summary: Your standard weapon.
flavor: The Basic Cannon is unwavering its determination to smite enemies.  It may not look like much, but it gets the job done.

name: Heavy Cannon
summary: Slower recharge rate but deals heavier damage.
flavor: Please use responsibly.

name: Machine Gun
summary: Fires bullets at twice the rate of the Basic Cannon.
flavor: What's different about the machine gun that makes it fire faster, and where do these bubble bullets come from anyway?  The world may never know.

name: Super Machine Gun
summary: Twice the damage of a standard Machine Gun.
flavor: The Super Machine Gun takes bubble machine guns to a whole new level.  Did we mention that it's super?

name: Dual Large MG
summary: Fires 2 heavy bullets side by side at rapid speed.
flavor: The Dual Large Machine Gun is so powerful that many people don't believe it even exists!  A weapon of legend, we think you'll like having it on your tank.

name: 2 Parallel
summary: Fires 2 bullets side by side.
flavor: The 2 Parallel is an awesome weapon with its 2 focused bullets.  Honestly, what CAN'T it do? \"Fire 3 bullets,\" says 3 Parallel.

name: 3 Spread
summary: Fires 3 bullets in 3 directions.
flavor: \"You know what's better than firing one bullet? Firing THREE bullets!\" says 3 Spread, despite the other weapons criticizing his lack of focus.  We'll let you be the judge.

name: 5 Spread
summary: Fires 5 bullets in 5 directions.
flavor: The 5 Spread makes aiming a thing of the past.  Just point anywhere and hold the mouse button, the screen will be filled with bullets going everywhere.

name: Pierce Cannon
summary: Slow refire rate, but the bullets can pass through multiple enemies.
flavor: Unstoppable AND unpoppable. 'Nuff said.

name: Exploding Pierce Cannon
summary: Fires bullets that pass through enemies, exploding on each impact.
flavor: Making your bullets explode on impact seems like such a good idea, you'd wonder why every weapon didn't do it.

name: Leech Cannon
summary: Fires bullets that give you life whenever they damage the enemy.
flavor: The Leech Cannon believes health points are something to be shared, mostly when those health points belong to other tanks.  He's so greedy.

name: Bullet Buster
summary: Enemy bullets stick to BB shells, allowing you to push them away from yourself.
flavor: Bullet Buster is a lover, not a fighter.  Says Bullet Buster: \"We're just a bunch of bubbles anyways, what's with all the violence?\"

name: Mega Cannon
summary: A Heavy Cannon designed for huge tanks.
flavor: You must be 46 inches tall to use Mega Cannon.

name: Bubble Thrower
summary: Throw streams of bubbles at your enemies.
flavor: A flame thrower would be sweet, but it just wouldn't be practical for the current environment. In comes the Bubble Thrower, the flame thower's alternative for high-fluid environments.

name: Ricochet Gun
summary: Fires bullets that bounce around the bubble field.
flavor: Other bullets give up when they miss, these guys bounce back and keep trying!

name: Beam Cannon
summary: Maintains a beam of energy as long as you hold the fire button.
flavor: I'MA FIRIN MAH- No. Just no.

name: Repulsor Cannon
summary: Repels enemy tanks, killing them if they are pushed out of the bubblefield.
flavor: Get away from me! GET AWAY!

name: 3 Parallel
summary: Fires 3 bullets side by side.
flavor: Actually does fire 3 bullet side by side. \"You son of a gun...\" says 2 Parallel

name: Sticky Burst
summary: Fires a ring of sticky bullets.
flavor: Sticky bubbles?  I guess it makes more sense than bubbles that explode on impact.  And this gun makes LOTS of sticky bubbles.

name: Stun Burst
summary: Nearby enemies are stunned and cannot move or attack.
flavor: Do Bubble Tanks have brains?  Maybe they have drivers?  Not sure, but somehow this weapon is able to stun those tanks really well.

name: Area Burst
summary: Deals damage to surrounding tanks.
flavor: For those who want an up close and personal battle and are looking for that more intimate fighting, the Area Burst is for you.  Just fly into a group of enemies and let loose.

name: Area Burst Cannon
summary: Fires bullets that explode, dealing damage to an area.
flavor: You don't need to have really good aim to hit enemies with the Area Burst Cannon.  Just aim for the general vicinity.

name: Star Burst
summary: A powerful bullet that explodes, releasing a ring of piercing bullets.
flavor: It's so pretty...

name: Drone Converter
summary: Puts all enemy drones under your control.
flavor: Something about the Drone Converter just makes enemy drones want to die for you instead of their past master.  Not sure why they feel the need to kamikaze in the first place.

name: Ally Bay: Swarm
summary: Spawns allies that will fight for you.
flavor: You know what's more fun than blowing up tanks by yourself?  Blowing them up with friends!  And with the Ally Bay, you can buy some friends! You'll be so popular!

name: Massive Cannon
summary: A massive weapon that can obliterate enemies.
flavor: This is the gun all other Bubble Tanks weapons aspire to be.

name: Seekers
summary: Fires seekers which hunt enemies.
flavor: These little guys can smell your fear.

name: Shield
summary: Allows you to become invincible for a short time.
flavor: Ha ha! You can't hit me!

name: Teleport Before
summary: Teleports to mouse location before executing weapon fires.
flavor: The Teleport Before jumps the gun and gets things done.

name: Teleport After
summary: Teleports to mouse location after executing weapon fires.
flavor: The Teleport After allows all other secondary weapons to finish their business before making the leap.  It's rude to interrupt.

name: Doomsday Infector
summary: Infects enemies, dealing damage over time. Infected enemies spawn 2 more Infectors upon death.
flavor: This weapon breaks every biological warfare treaty ever written.

name: Bubble Whip
summary: Short-range, 360 degree attack.
flavor: Now you can whip the enemy tanks literally AND figuratively!

name: Rocket Launcher
summary: Fires ten rockets.
flavor: Psew! Psew! PsewPsewPsew! WHOOSH... KA-BOOOOM!

name: Ally Bay: Mine Layer
summary: Spawns allies that will lay mines for you.
flavor: Laying mines is a very tedious task. That's why you should convince your friends to do it for you! Just make sure they tell you where they put them.

name: Apocalypse Cannon
summary: Fires a bullet that destroys the Bubblefield when it reaches the boundary.
flavor: Your enemies better inform everyone they know of their impending doom when this gun is fired.

name: Radar
summary: Points out enemies that are off screen.
flavor: Shouldn't it be called 'Sonar'?

name: Health Readout
summary: Displays healthbars for all enemies.
flavor: We see your weakness.

name: Auto Cannon
summary: Basic Cannon that auto-targets and fires.
flavor: If you want something done right, let another gun do it.

name: Seeker Flak
summary: Targets enemy seeker missiles with short-range bursts.
flavor: You seek me, I seek you.

name: Forcefield
summary: Blocks 5 enemy bullets before going down for 10 seconds. Recharges 1 deflection every second when active.
flavor: Dodging bullets is now optional.

name: Orbital Seekers
summary: Spawns orbiting seeking missles around you.
flavor: Round and round they go, what they'll hit knowbody knows. Says Orbital Seeker: \"We'll just hang here should you need us\"

name: Basic Cannon
summary: Your standard enemy weapon.
flavor: This is the standard gun on most bad guys. Looks simple, but when facing a few enemies with this weapon it can get tough quick.

name: Seekers
summary: Emits drones which will seek out the target and explode upon impact.
flavor: Bubblefields don't offer many good hiding places.  If you're still alive, seekers will find you to put an end to that.

name: Enemy Spawner
summary: Creates small fighter enemies.
flavor: Taking up the family business of attacking tanks is fine and good, but Enemy Spawner would love to have at least one kid be a doctor.

name: 3 Spread
summary: Fires 3 bullets in 3 directions.
flavor: Getting away from 3 Spread can be difficult.  Me?  I've moved out of town and changed my name.  You can't ever be too safe.

name: 3 Parallel
summary: Fires 3 bullets side by side.
flavor: This weapon is great for kids not ready for the 5 Parallel experience yet.

name: 5 Parallel
summary: Fires 5 bullets side by side.
flavor: It took 7 Hero Interactive interns to decide that gluing 5 basic cannons side by side was going to be awesome.

name: 5 Spread
summary: Fires 5 bullets in 5 directions.
flavor: Some critics wonder why we never went further to create the 7 Spread. You're looking into the future, but I'm afrad the technology for 7 Spread simply doesn't exist yet.

name: 360 Spread
summary: Fires bullets in 360 degrees.
flavor: Don't hate on the 360's general lack of aiming skill. 4 out of 5 dentists agree: this gun is going to hit you.

name: Mine Dropper
summary: Drops immobile mines.
flavor: Most bullets are wasted when they miss their target. Mines have decided to wait, sit still, and contemplate their existence until you hit them.

name: Orbital Seeker
summary: Spawns orbiting seeker missles around the enemy.
flavor: Round and round they go, what they'll hit knowbody knows. Says Orbital Seeker: \"We'll just hang here should you need us.\"

name: Sticky Gun
summary: Fires sticky bullets which briefly slow down the player's tank.
flavor: What makes these bullets so sticky?  You don't wanna know.

name: Sapper Drone
summary: These drones seek out the player's tank, damage it, then return a portion of life to their creator.
flavor: The neighborhood has really gotten rough since Sapper Drones came to town. Says the Sapper: \"Hey your life looks good. Can I hold it?\"

name: Seeker Carrier
summary: Pops and releases Seeker Drones when shot by player.
flavor: We've always wondered what sort of dark little secrets were inside of those big yellow bubbles. \"Shoot it.  You know you want to.\" says the Carrier.

name: Rotating Machine Gun
summary: Shoots many powerful bullets in a circle.
flavor: Don't mock the fact that this weapon freaks out and shoots everywhere, this is the gun that makes many BT3 players break down and cry.

name: Heavy Cannon
summary: Fires bigger, slower, more damaging bullets.
flavor: Making more destructive bubble weapons is a careful and precise science few can comprehend.  This gun shoots bigger bullets!

name: Machine Gun
summary: Fires many bullets in rapid succession.
flavor: The Machine Gun just realized that if you keep holding down the trigger, the bullets keep flying out.  I hope he keeps this secret to himself.

name: Ink Gun
summary: Fires ink bullets that temporarily obstruct the player's view.
flavor: This gun took a few lessons from its friend, the squid.

name: Spin-Fire
summary: Fires one large bullet that then fires lots of smaller bullets.
flavor: This bullet parts the seas with destruction!

name: Rocket Launcher
summary: Fires ten rockets.
flavor: You might be able to dodge nine rockets, but ten? Psshhhh.

name: Seeker Mine Dropper
summary: Drops camouflaged mines that gravitate toward the player's tank when it gets near.
flavor: If the regular mines had the right idea, these things are the Einsteins of the bullet world.

name: Seeker Mine Pod
summary: When tank is destroyed, spawns camouflaged mines that gravitate toward the player's tank when it gets near.
flavor: If the regular mines had the right idea, these things are the Einsteins of the bullet world.

name: Neutralizer
summary: If an Apocalypse Cannon is fired, this weapon will emit a blast that neutralizes its effect.
flavor: It's like the antacid of the bubblefield world.

name: Ripple Generator
summary: Pushes tanks away. The smaller the tank the further they go.
flavor: This is my bubble field! You get outta here!

name: Jamming Gun
summary: Fires jamming bullets that briefly prevent the player's tank from firing its weapons.
flavor: Haha, look at them stare at you in confusion as they try to keep firing.

name: Spike
summary: Damages and knocks back any opposing tank that collides with it.
flavor: Can't touch this. Well, actually you can, but we don't recommend it.

name: Shield Turrets
summary: Builds turrets that protect the tank from damage.
flavor: \"Haha, you can't hurt- HEY! DON'T TOUCH THAT!!\"

name: Aggressor
summary: Causes the enemy to seek out the player's Bubble Tank.
flavor: CHAAAAARRRRRGGEE!!

name: Healer
summary: Allows the enemy to heal other enemies.
flavor: MEDIC!

name: Skittish
summary: Causes the enemy to avoid the player's Bubble Tank.
flavor: Fear? Or strategy? You decide.

name: Phasing
summary: Causes the enemy to alternate between visible and invisible.
flavor: Now you see him, now you don't! Oh wait, there he is.

name: Wall Flower
summary: The tank will circle the edge of the bubblefield.
flavor: You make me dizzy...

name: Ally Auto Cannon
summary: Basic Cannon that auto targets and fires.
flavor: If you want something done right, let another gun do it.
